messages:
Alyssa Chen: FYI - MapleHealth says the March promo credit didn't apply and they were billed full. Customer reported invoice INV-2026-0392 for $4,200. They asked for a manual credit. @Ben can you take a look? :eyes:

Ben Liu: On it. Can you paste the subscription id and any screenshots? I pulled INV-2026-0392: invoice_total=4200, status=paid, promo_id not present on that invoice.

Alyssa Chen: They gave subs id sub_mpl_0043 and billing contact emma@maplehealth.com. They claim the promo "SPRING50" should've applied (50% off March usage up to $2,000).

Ben Liu: Thanks. Quick math: March usage 4200 -> promo cap 2000 -> expected credit = 2000. Options: issue credit note (CN-1783) for $2,000, refund the overpayment via Stripe, or post adjustment on next invoice. Given they're paid and want resolution now, credit note is clean. Need approval for accounting code and sign-off.

Ben Liu: Proposed adjustment: create credit note CN-1783, amount=2000, apply to INV-2026-0392, accounting_code=6543, reason=\"missed promo - SPRING50\". Also record as AR adjustment in March.

Ravi Patel: @Ben I approve the manual credit. Please include the customer confirmation and flag for audit. Mark as non-recurring and use code 6543. :thumbsup:

Ben Liu: Thanks - creating now. Running command: 
```
/create-credit --invoice INV-2026-0392 --amount 2000 --currency USD --reason "missed promo SPRING50" --acct_code 6543 --apply_immediately true
```

billing-bot: Credit created CN-1783, amount $2,000, applied to INV-2026-0392. Ledger note appended: \"manual promo credit per CS request (Alyssa Chen) - customer notified\". Posted to accounting queue (GL 1200/6543).

Ben Liu: Notified emma@maplehealth.com and CC'd account manager Emma Gomez. Sent receipt and updated invoice PDF.

Emma Gomez: I messaged the customer with the credit note and apology. They replied \"thank you\" and asked for a short note for their finance team - sent CN-1783 + a one-line explanation.

Ben Liu: Closing the thread - keeping a copy in billing adjustments for March. Audit tag: \"manual_credit_MAPLE_2026_03\". If anything else from MapleHealth ping me.

Alyssa Chen: Awesome, thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
thread_summary: MapleHealth missed promo credit on INV-2026-0392; finance approved and issued a $2,000 credit note CN-1783 applied to the invoice.
